startCommand: mkdir -p storage/app/public storage/framework/cache/data storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views storage/logs bootstrap/cache && exec frankenphp run --config /etc/frankenphp/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
releaseCommands:
php -r '$k=getenv("APP_KEY");$p=getenv("DB_PASSWORD");if(!$k||!$p){fwrite(STDERR,"Missing required APP_KEY or DB_PASSWORD
");exit(1);}$r=getenv("DB_ROOT_PASSWORD");$d=getenv("DB_DATABASE");$u=getenv("DB_USERNAME");$h=getenv("DB_HOST")?:"mariadb";$port=getenv("DB_PORT")?:"3306";if(!$r||!$d||!$u){fwrite(STDERR,"Skip DB auto-provision: link DB service to inject DB_ROOT_PASSWORD
");exit(0);}if(!preg_match("/^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$/",$d)||!preg_match("/^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$/",$u)){fwrite(STDERR,"Invalid DB_DATABASE or DB_USERNAME
");exit(1);}try{$pdo=new PDO("mysql:host=$h;port=$port;charset=utf8mb4","root",$r,[PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE=>PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]);$pdo->exec("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `$d` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci");$s=$pdo->prepare("CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS ?@"%" IDENTIFIED BY ?");$s->execute([$u,$p]);$s=$pdo->prepare("ALTER USER ?@"%" IDENTIFIED BY ?");$s->execute([$u,$p]);$pdo->exec("GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `$d`.* TO "$u"@"%"");$pdo->exec("FLUSH PRIVILEGES");echo "DB & user ready: $d ($u)
";}catch(PDOException $e){fwrite(STDERR,"DB provision failed ($h:$port): ".$e->getMessage()." — link MariaDB app in OpenShip (Use in a project / Topology)
");exit(1);}'
